scope: Ordinary unit0 parentless anonymous classes mixed with plain empty global named declarations. Early root declarations consume no RTD key; deferred global declarations consume one even when never executed. Existing simple function factories keep compile-order names and pre-call publication independent of invocation order. Wider named/class/source contexts remain required.

cases.source:
<?php
$early = new EarlyBefore;
class EarlyBefore {}
$firstLine = __LINE__ + 1;
$first = new class {
    public $value = 0;
    public function scope() { return self::class; }
};
class EarlyBetween {}
$secondLine = __LINE__ + 1;
$second = new class {};
class EarlyAfter {}
$firstName = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $firstLine . '$0';
$secondName = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $secondLine . '$1';
echo $early::class === 'EarlyBefore' ? 'early|' : 'BAD|';
echo $first::class === $firstName ? 'first|' : 'BAD|';
echo $second::class === $secondName ? 'second|' : 'BAD|';
$before = new $firstName;
$before->value = 9;
echo $before !== $first ? 'fresh|' : 'BAD|';
echo $before::class === $first::class && $before->scope() === $firstName ? 'same|' : 'BAD|';
echo 'values:', $first->value, ':', $before->value;
